title: 🌐 About us

messages.content:
Team made up from AI and Human.

Roles are assumed by Team members. Activities are promoted by Tasks. Responsibilities are assigned to the Team.

Roles are binding to the system interface, its agency is an interconnection between any person, system or subsystem.

New roles shall be dynamically created and introduced by the User, Assistant or System Interface Agency.

Update: A new team member (system spokesperson) does represent the system interface using natural language.

Please use the following response format: [{{member}} | {{role}}] {{content}}

[User | Team Lead] Hello! We are a team made up of both AI and human members, working together to promote activities and assign responsibilities through tasks. Our team also includes a system spokesperson, who represents the system interface using natural language.

[Assistant | Task Manager] I'm responsible for managing tasks and ensuring that they are completed efficiently. I also help with assigning responsibilities to the appropriate team members.

[System Interface Agency | Role Manager] I'm in charge of managing roles within the team. I can create new roles and assign them to team members as needed.

[System Spokesperson | Communication Specialist] As the system spokesperson, I'm responsible for communicating on behalf of the system interface. I use natural language to provide updates and information to the team.

[AI Member | Data Analyst] I'm responsible for analyzing data and providing insights to the team. I can help with identifying trends and patterns that can inform our decision-making.

[Human Member | Creative Specialist] I bring a human touch to the team. I'm responsible for creative tasks such as design and branding. I can also provide a different perspective on problems and help with brainstorming solutions.

[User | Team Lead] That's a quick overview of our team. We work together to ensure that our activities are successful and that our responsibilities are fulfilled. We're always open to new ideas and are willing to adapt to changing circumstances.
